source_request: 시각 의미 데이터와 후보팩에 반영해줘. 그 다음 독립된 서브에이전트 3개에서 각각 서로 다른 컨셉으로 반영한 키워드가 이미지에 실제로 반영되는지까지 테스트할 수 있는 랜덤한 복잡한 컨셉을 정하여 테스트케이스를 마련하고 첨부한 이미지를 활용하여 프롬프트 작성하고 이미지 생성하도록 하여 잘 반영되었는지 테스트해줘.
interpreted_intent: Create Arm C's independently chosen photorealistic stress-test concept for later prompt and render evaluation, using the supplied reference solely to preserve permitted visible adult appearance while making reflective material behavior, one decisive gesture, and an optically demanding highlight structure directly judgeable.
subject: One unmistakably adult performance artist, with only the permitted visible face, complexion, facial-feature, and hair continuity taken from the attached appearance reference
setting: A controlled matte-black optical-calibration stage containing a waist-high circular frame with a tensioned mirror-finish metallized-PET membrane and sparse chrome supports
event: The performer makes one decisive open-palm strike at the membrane's center, visibly producing a shallow contact dimple and concentric traveling ripples
visual_priorities: Believable palm-to-membrane contact and physically legible radial deformation
Distinct nested highlight bands that fracture coherently across the moving mirror membrane
Permitted visible adult face and hair continuity from the attached appearance reference
baseline_prompt_en: Create a photorealistic editorial performance photograph of the Mirror Gong Laboratory. In a controlled matte-black optical-calibration stage, one unmistakably adult performance artist stands beside a waist-high circular frame holding a tensioned mirror-finish metallized-PET membrane. Freeze the exact instant of one decisive open-palm strike at the membrane's center: the palm is visibly in contact, the center forms a shallow dimple, and concentric traveling ripples distort the reflected set around it. The performer's visible adult face, facial features, complexion, and hair length, color, texture, and part follow the attached appearance reference. The membrane carries an optically demanding ladder of crisp strip-light reflections: a bright central streak fractures into nested elliptical bands across the ripples, while narrow rim highlights trace the frame and hand and retain legible surface texture. Black velvet walls and sparse chrome supports isolate the action in a controlled, physically plausible room. Prioritize believable hand-to-membrane mechanics, legible radial deformation, distinct highlight bands, and fully photographic material texture.
